description: This file manages in-app messaging for the Notesnook mobile app, including displaying various user messages, handling message state, and triggering UI actions such as navigation and dialogs.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Type definition for in-app messages, including properties like visibility, message text, icon, type, and actions.

methods.name: showMessageById
methods.description: Sets the current message based on the provided message ID.

methods.name: setRateAppMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'Rate App' message to the user.

methods.name: setRecoveryKeyMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'Recovery Key' message to the user.

methods.name: setLoginMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'Login' message to the user.

methods.name: setEmailVerifyMessage
methods.description: Displays the 'Email Verification' message to the user.

methods.name: setUpdateAvailableMessage
methods.description: Displays a message indicating an app update is available.
